parameters.content: ## LLM Eval Harness v0.1.0 (walking skeleton)\nLocal eval-harness API: receives an eval run with inline golden cases, runs a deterministic STUB subject-under-test, scores each output with the 5-type deterministic assertion taxonomy (schema/range/format/absence/masking) FIRST, grades residual subjective dims with a deterministic STUB judge (1..5 groundedness/relevance/helpfulness/safety), aggregates pass-rate + per-rubric mean with judgeTrust:"high" (stub), and emits a redacted audit event. Stub default keeps the Layer-2 suite offline + reproducible. DEFERRED: live model fan-out (Ollama/cloud), mode:"workflow" calling product-feedback, regression-vs-previous-run, human-labeled calibration. Manual trigger runs an editor demo; webhook serves the API.
